purpose: Direct indexed-page original printed 1910 facsimile screening of all 54 source-unaddressable citations. The locators are navigation aids and not certification of the printed marginal reference strings.
caveat: The original DjVu whole-file OCR form-feed stream can drift from native image page numbers. Locators are generated from independently requested djvutxt -page=N texts and ddjvu -page=N image frames. OCR is used only for verse page finding, not for authorial print-note certification. A separate printed-note check is required to change historical_print_status.
